aspect: It consumes the same capacity the work needs
description: Vigilance and contingency planning occupy working memory, so the cognitive cost shows up as ordinary tiredness and ordinary mistakes rather than as anything nameable.
energy_note: Not worried. Just slower, all the time.

aspect: Every routine act has a second calculation
description: Driving, being paid, going to a clinic, arguing with a landlord - each carries a second column nobody around him is computing.
energy_note: Two calculations where everyone else does one.

aspect: It is invisible and therefore uncredited
description: Colleagues see the output, not the overhead, so he is compared on equal terms with people running one process fewer.

A bulb has gone on the rear plate. For anyone else it is a job for Saturday. For him it is a reason to be stopped, so he drives to the parts shop at ten at night, in the rain, and fixes it in the car park with a phone torch.
energy_note: Fixing a bulb at ten at night, because of what it could become.
